title: Periscope
definition: An optical instrument that utilizes reflection via plane mirrors or total internal reflection through prisms to allow observation of objects from a concealed, obstructed, or elevated position.
importanceInUpsc: Tested in UPSC Prelims GS-1 (Science & Technology - Physics/Optics) through direct applications of laws of reflection, critical angles, and military/naval hardware mechanics.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational ray-optics principles governing periscopes including reflection and prism alignment.
Evaluate structural differences between simple tube periscopes and advanced submarine optical/photonic periscopes.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims optical and physics application questions.
